command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=d4f9ef9b4a4cb1f55c50e6353e37d35b6ebbdf35; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()'); TMP=$(mktemp -d); python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --bind 127.0.0.1 >"$TMP/http.out" 2>"$TMP/http.err" & HTTP_PID=$!; cloudflared tunnel --url "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" --no-autoupdate >"$TMP/cf.out" 2>"$TMP/cf.err" & CF_PID=$!; cleanup(){ kill "$CF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$CF_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; kill "$HTTP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$HTTP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; URL=''; for i in $(seq 1 100); do URL=$(grep -Eo 'https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com' "$TMP/cf.err" | head -n1 || true); [ -n "$URL" ] && break; sleep 0.2; done; test -n "$URL"; HOST=$(printf '%s' "$URL" | sed 's#https://##'); echo quick_tunnel_host=$HOST; START=$(date +%s); RESOLVED=''; for i in $(seq 1 120); do RESOLVED=$(dig @1.1.1.1 +short "$HOST" | paste -sd, -); if [ -n "$RESOLVED" ]; then NOW=$(date +%s); echo dns_elapsed_seconds=$((NOW-START)); echo dns_records=$RESOLVED; break; fi; sleep 1; done; if [ -z "$RESOLVED" ]; then echo dns_unresolved_after_seconds=120; grep -E 'Registered tunnel connection|Failed to serve tunnel connection|Unable to establish connection|ERR|error|protocol' "$TMP/cf.err" | tail -n 30 | sed 's/^/cloudflared=/' || true; exit 1; fi; CODE=''; for i in $(seq 1 30); do CODE=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 "$URL/" 2>/dev/null || true); [ "$CODE" = 200 ] && break; sleep 1; done; echo public_http_code=$CODE; test "$CODE" = 200; cleanup; trap - EXIT; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo quick_tunnel_dns_propagation_green=true
